metadata.description: A library of web design skills for AI coding agents: each one teaches a complete visual style, with a reference site, screenshots and copy-ready components.

plugins.name: paper-notebook-landing
plugins.description: Landing pages in a warm paper-notebook style: cream paper, chunky soft serif, handwritten notes, sticky notes, a scroll-opening notebook, comic strips and a giant footer.

plugins.name: noir-gradient-law
plugins.description: Law-firm and advisory websites in a noir gradient style: pure black, bronze statue photography, a yellow-orange-red fire gradient, giant uppercase headlines, duotone-halftone photos and a 3D review carousel.

plugins.name: portal-webgl-studio
plugins.description: Immersive studio and agency sites: a full-screen three.js portal behind monospace UI, slash-scramble preloader, film grain, a 3D glass project gallery, an ask-me-anything terminal and ambient sound.

plugins.name: pointcloud-matrix-tech
plugins.description: Technology, data and AI product sites as a dark engineering document: matrix rain background, magnetic cursor, three.js point-cloud hero attracted to the mouse, voxel and wireframe twin visuals.

plugins.name: neumorphic-club-fintech
plugins.description: Premium fintech, card and membership sites in two-material neumorphism: a dark relief page with light relief cards, panels and coins, a cursor-driven light source, engraved scroll-reveal text, a tilting embossed card and a slide-to-join control.

plugins.name: scroll-lock-cyber-brutalism
plugins.description: Privacy and security product sites in postmodern cyber brutalism: night graphite, hairline grid with amber crosshairs, mono readouts, and a three.js padlock the visitor closes by scrolling, plus honest threat-model, crypto and download-verification sections.

plugins.name: gravity-lens-space
plugins.description: Cinematic space and launch sites: light editorial page with mouse-reactive dark windows — WebGL black-hole lens, hover video previews, floating astronaut, time-dilation calculator, cursor-reactive headlines.

plugins.name: network-journey-webgl
plugins.description: Immersive, scroll-driven 3D product sites in the igloo.inc tradition, built to production standards: one Three.js world behind HTML chapters, HUD and pinned tags, particle morphs, quality tiers with stills, strict CSP and Playwright + axe tests.

plugins.name: aperture-topology-story
plugins.description: Developer-tool, data and OSINT product sites: a glowing SVG node-topology hero on a dark grid, then a pinned scroll story where a circular aperture opens from the central node onto a light paper workspace and cards act out the product's workflow, plus an architecture switcher, catalog table and terminal.

plugins.name: flight-path-roadmap
plugins.description: Gamified travel-themed homepages: a plane cursor with contrails, a scroll-driven flight through numbered gates with HUD, miles, unlock toasts and a landing scene, a boarding-pass hero form, ticket pricing tiers, a split-flap departures board, travel extras and a travel-fund impact section.

plugins.name: orbit-poster-editorial
plugins.description: Editorial, poster-like homepages: deep ink and warm paper, giant tight type with an outlined line, a mouse-reactive CSS planet in 3D orbits with floating paper cards, a particle network, and real photos printed into posters in grayscale multiply under huge letters, with colour on hover.

plugins.name: knockout-quest-app
plugins.description: Experimental, gamified mobile-app landing pages: a video inside a giant knockout wordmark that scrolling zooms into, a 3D phone with a sticky tour of real screenshots, playable daily quests with a live XP bar, level-ups and confetti, video tiles with a fitness HUD and a sound studio with music, nature sounds and a radio tuner.

plugins.name: glyph-bench-sheets
plugins.description: Experimental product sites for PDF, document and font tools: a black hero made of glyphs in the app's own bundled fonts with a scan-to-searchable slider, white sheets with rounded tops over a dark bench, a rail of tall tool cards, tab chips over live tool demos, a type card for every bundled font and a dark video grid.
